Giả sử một căn có giá chưa VAT và phí bả: Suppose a unit's price excluding VAT and the maintenance fee is 3 billion VND (a round number for illustration, not a specific unit price). At a project with a 5% no-loan discount, a buyer on the standard schedule saves about 150 million VND. If choosing 95% early payment at a project offering 10%, the extra discount is calculated on the remaining price after the earlier incentives – total savings could be several hundred million VND. In return, the buyer must pay almost everything early, so compare this with deposit interest over the waiting period until handover. The developer's price calculation sheet for each unit is the only exact figure.
